answer_1.quote: The coding capability is tested on LiveCodeBench-v1.0 (Naman Jain, 2024), which is also a commonly used code generation benchmark.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates reasoning chains and code solutions as outputs for mathematical and coding tasks.

answer_2.quote: On math tasks, we record the correctness of the answers as the accuracy (Acc.). On code generation benchmark, we report Pass@1 to measure the generation quality.

answer_3.quote: We utilize Qwen2.5-coder-7B-Instruct as the generation model and skywork-reward-llama-3.1-8B as the reward model.
